rationale: Price is at 97.4% of today's range and within 0.12% of the session high after a strong momentum run, making a long entry at this level a poor risk/reward proposition with minimal room before the natural resistance at the high. A short against the prevailing broad market strength (SPY +4.69%, VIXY -14.34%) and clear upward price momentum in the last five candles carries significant counter-trend risk. With no clean setup in either direction and today already showing a small realized loss, the prudent action is to wait for a pullback or consolidation that offers a defined entry with better reward-to-risk geometry.
